text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Parliament began to debate proposed amendments to the Constitution and the judicial system.
- Parliament's economics committee voted down an opposition proposal to set up a special committee on Postabank.
- The sacking of a secret service official for his involvement in the monitoring of members of parliament is permanent.
- Economic think-tank Penzugykutato Rt said the 1995 austerity measures dubbed the "Bokros package" were successful but further steps will not be needed either this year or in 1998.
- The Slovak government is not considering rebuilding a bridge on the Danube on the Hungarian-Slovak border.
